name: Caminho de Tejo
description_md:
Caminho de Tejo is a waymarked hiking route in PT that covers 57.9 km. The route features 1182 m of ascent and 939 m of descent, requiring about 17 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This hard route belongs to the national waymarked hiking network and derives its difficulty rating from distance and ascent. During the journey, the way passes Fatima within 100 m. It also goes near Cabeço dos Valinhos within 600 m and Moinhos da Fazarga within 1900 m.
